node.html: Implemented a CNN for estimating the human pose as a part of the neural networks & deep learning course
The purpose of this study is to develop and deploy an Open Source Intelligent Online Proctoring System that uses artificial intelligence to monitor online tests.

Through this project we intend to digitize and simplify the ways in which cricket players’ statistics are analyzed and maintained. The major objective of this application is to minimize the cumbersome process that usually takes place while analyzing and maintaining the stats.

• Webapp features : Login Management, Profile Management, Address-book Management, Managing emails.
  • Project developed in an agile development workflow.
